I have only this small piece of land, so I must care for it with what I have. I will put goat and chicken manure that I collected during the dry season onto the plot, because I cannot afford the expensive chemical fertilizer from the market. The cuttings I saved from last harvest are good enough for planting, and my children and I will do the clearing, planting, and weeding ourselves when the rains come. I do not need to pay anyone to help since the plot is small, and we always manage with our own hands.
